name: The Hexblade
summary: A pact with a sentient weapon from the Shadowfell; a melee warlock.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.short: Smites and battle spells join your warlock list.
features.summary: The Hexblade adds these spells to the warlock spell list for you; learn them like other warlock spells.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.short: Bonus action: curse a target for bonus damage and crits on 19-20.
features.summary: As a bonus action, curse a creature within 30 ft. for 1 minute: add your proficiency bonus to damage rolls against it, crit on 19 or 20 against it, and regain warlock level + CHA hit points if it dies. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.short: Medium armor, shields, martial weapons; CHA for your pact weapon.
features.summary: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons. After a long rest, choose a one-handed weapon you are proficient with: you can use CHA instead of STR or DEX for its attack and damage rolls (also your pact weapon).

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.short: Raise a slain humanoid as a specter servant.
features.summary: When you slay a humanoid, you can cause its spirit to rise as a specter that serves you until your next long rest, with temporary hit points equal to half your warlock level. Once per long rest.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.short: Reaction: your cursed target misses you half the time.
features.summary: If the target of your Hexblade's Curse hits you, you can use your reaction to roll a d6; on a 4 or higher the attack misses.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.short: Move your curse to a new creature when the target dies.
features.summary: When the creature cursed by Hexblade's Curse dies, you can apply the curse to another creature within 30 ft. (without regaining hit points).
